About
I lead three teams (platform, developer productivity and reliability) at a fintech scale-up. We run everything on Kubernetes with Istio as the service mesh, ship through Flux, and treat cost optimization and FinOps as a product. Before that I was an Engineering Manager for an observability team that adopted OpenTelemetry early.

I write about engineering leadership, hiring and running platform teams like products. Co-founder of a small meetup for platform folks in the Bay Area.
